items.prompt: Why append the accepted int ID before assigning cash/position?

options.text: Scalar assignments must always allocate memory
A rejected fill should deliberately consume its ID
options.why: This contract does not consume rejected IDs.

options.text: The potential vector allocation can fail before scalar commit
options.why: For this vector<int> case a failed append leaves state unchanged.

options.text: This ordering proves crash-safe disk atomicity
options.why: It is only an in-memory single-threaded exception argument.

items.explanation: The proof depends on int element/vector guarantees and nonthrowing scalar assignments, not a generic atomicity slogan.
